impact: This branch is broader than a pure PAL clink extension.
It bootstraps the minimal auditor-router runtime needed for PAL clink classification tests.
No claim is made that the full CLI wrapper contract is complete.

route_behavior.implemented: PAL MCP clink bridge-tier classification by static config inspection.

fixes: Allowed Copilot FALLBACK_ONLY selection now returns exit 0 when --allow-fallback is provided.
PAL clink audit finding normalization preserves explicit blocking=true markers before verdict classification.
Unsafe or mismatched PAL clink audit configs emit schema-safe underlying_cli=null instead of invalid CLI strings.
Non-object PAL clink JSON config payloads are classified TOOLING_UNSAFE instead of crashing.
PAL clink audit configs now require command to match the expected CLI exactly.
PAL clink config discovery now models clink override order so later override configs replace built-in audit configs.
PAL clink audit configs now require explicit name and runner fields before availability.
PAL clink role scanning now rejects non-object roles and role values without crashing preflight.

follow_up_resolution.note: The wrapper blocker was historical for PAL-CLINK-002 and is closed by the follow-up wrapper packet. PAL MCP clink was executed host-side; clink session sandbox blocked all evidence file reads. Audit output captured but verdict is NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.
